id: The Hobbit: The Desolation of Smaug (2013)
title: The Hobbit: The Desolation of Smaug
tagline: Barrels of fish. Barrels of fun.
about: Bilbo and the dwarves cross Mirkwood and Lake-town to reach the dragon in the mountain.
cue: Serve the mains when the dwarves are smuggled into Lake-town in Bard's fish barrels.
faces: Elvenking's baked brie with grape juice figs

finish with parmesan and pepper.Elvenking's baked brie with grape juice figsThranduil's halls and the elves' grape juice cellarHow to make itAs written, serves 4A whole brie baked until oozing, topped with figs stewed in grape juice and honey, with walnuts, grapes and crackers for scooping.Simmer 6 halved dried figs in 125ml grape juice with 1 tbsp honey and a thyme sprig for 10 minutes until sticky.Score the top of a 200g brie, sit it in a small dish and bake at 180°C for 15 minutes until soft in the middle.Spoon the figs and syrup over the top and scatter with toasted walnuts.Serve apples, halvedScore the pork skin and rub with salt and fennel seeds.Leave uncovered in the fridge overnight.Roast at 160°C, brushing the meat side with honey.Add the apple halves and roast for the last part of the cooking.Blast at 240°C until the crackling is golden.Rest before carving.Lake-town whole roast snapperBard smuggling the dwarves in barrels of fishHow to make itAs written, serves 4Whole snapper roasted with lemon, garlic and parsley at 200°C for 25 minutes, served with roast potatoes and greens.Score 2 whole snapper of about 800g each on both sides.Stuff with lemon slices, garlic and parsley stalks and rub with olive oil and salt.Parboil 800g halved potatoes for 8 minutes and roast at 200°C in oil for 20 minutes first.Lay the fish on top of the potatoes and roast 25
